hook.line: Trying to get your website to the first page of Google? Do this first.
hook.visual: Woman with glasses on her head, wide eyes, talking close to camera; red banner 'HOW TO MAKE YOUR WEBSITE SHOW UP IN GOOGLE SEARCHES' and native captions.

beats.what: Promise: do this first to reach page one of Google
Search Console sign-up page screenshot over her, caption 'go to Google Search Console'
Domain verification screen: verify your domain ownership
Back to face, explains what a sitemap is
Sitemaps page in Search Console; 'don't panic if you don't know your sitemap URL'
Card listing sitemap URLs by platform (Wix, WordPress, alternatives)
Typing the sitemap URL and clicking submit on a phone screen
'Sitemap submitted successfully' confirmation as the payoff

why_it_works: Speaks at a fast measured 3.9 words/s with almost no silence (3%), so there is no gap to scroll away
Each step's screenshot appears exactly on the word that names it, so the viewer can copy along
A reference card of sitemap URLs per platform gives a reason to save (1588 shares)
Ends on the success screen, closing the promise made in the hook
weaknesses: Hook is generic SEO advice without a concrete result shown
Loud music bed (measured -6.6 dB) competes with fast speech
No follow or comment ask at the end
for_robert: Put each UI screenshot in on the exact word that names the step, with his face still visible; Fred could react to the 'submitted successfully' payoff.
